surface-budget.instructions: Create brief notes for an engineer continuing this work. Remove filler, repetition, and words that are safely inferable. Use fragments and ordinary short words, not invented abbreviations. Preserve all technical substance, especially exact identifiers, paths, commands, errors, numbers, units, negation, exceptions, uncertainty, causal or required order, failed approaches and why they failed, rollback or abort rules, open questions, success gates, and the next action. Prefer clarity over shortening when compression could change meaning. Do not announce the style.

records.text:
Regression: first bad v2.18.1, known-good v2.17.6. Service file: /srv/checkout/config/routes.yaml.
14:07 UTC: p95 182->947 ms, 502 0.4%->8.7%.
Order: deploy v2.18.1 -> schema migration 20260805_add_route_key -> error spike.
Failed: `kubectl rollout undo deploy/checkout -n payments --to-revision=41`. Restored pods, not DB schema; 502 stayed 7.9%. Not successful.
Constraint: do not delete column route_key while v2.18.1 workers exist (they write it).
Plan: forward-compatible rollback.
1. `kubectl scale deploy/checkout-canary -n payments --replicas=0`
2. Verify zero v2.18.1 pods.
3. `/opt/runbooks/checkout/rollback-db.sh --to 20260804 --dry-run`
   - If >250 affected rows: abort, page DB on-call.
   - If <=250: rerun without --dry-run, deploy v2.17.6.
Rollback of rollback: redeploy v2.18.1 only if replication lag <3 s AND schema checksum sha256:8dd15f03.
Uncertainty: 31 malformed route records may cause 502s (hypothesis, not finding).
Success: p95 <250 ms, 502 <1.0% for 15 min.
Open: did partner eu-west send empty route

Dup captures: cus_7K2 charged $48.20 x2 (09:41:12Z, 09:41:19Z). req_01J4Q9H8M2; cart_8841; pi_3Qe91, pi_3Qe94. Log /var/log/billing/capture-2026-08-05.jsonl: webhook arrived before 1st commit; retry missed idempotency row.
Failed: Redis TTL (30s). `redis-cli --raw TTL idem:req_01J4Q9H8M2` -> 24. Expiry not cause (7s gap). Ignore unless clock skew >23s.
Failed: Process-local mutex. `npm run bench -- --case duplicate-capture --workers 4` -> 6 dups/10k reqs (multi-pod). Do not retry unless single-process.
Constraints: Table lock <=50ms. No refund until FIN-482 approved.
Plan: Unique partial index `capture_once` on (merchant_id, idempotency_key) WHERE status != 'void'. Catch SQLSTATE 23505, return existing.
Risk: 17 hist rows have null idempotency_key.
Pre-mig: `/opt/billing/bin/audit-idem --since 2026-07-01 --format json > /tmp/idem-audit.json`. Keep file until PAY-771 closes.
Abort if: >3 dup non-null keys OR replica lag >=5s.
Rollback: `DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY capture_once`. Does not undo sent captures.
Unknown: Can pi_3Qe94 be voided?
Success: 0 dups in 1

Finish event-window in src/window/maxDistinct.ts. Input: sorted timestamps, may repeat. Window inclusive: retain j if ts[j] >= ts[i] - 3000. Output: max distinct user_id count. Memory O(k), k=active users. No window copies.

Failed: Set + delete on oldest exit. Counterexample: u17 at 1000, 2500. 1000 leaves, u17 stays. Set-only wrong unless 1 event/user (not guaranteed).
Failed: Sort copy by user_id per right endpoint. Correct but 18.4s on 2M events (target 2s).

Plan: Two pointers + Map<string, number> freq.
1. Advance right, inc freq.
2. Advance left while ts[right] - ts[left] > 3000. Dec freq; delete key if 0.
3. Shrink done: best = max(best, map.size).
Invariant: Before best, all active ts within 3000ms of ts[right]. Map count = occurrences in [left, right].
Keep `> 3000`. `>= 3000` makes boundary exclusive (wrong).

Test: `npm test -- --run tests/window/maxDistinct.test.ts`
Add cases:
[(1000,u17),(2500,u17),(4000,u22)] => 2
[(0,a),(3000,b)] => 2

Uncertainty: Unicode-normalized user ids may differ. Normalization outside contract; not confirmed bug.
Constraint: Do not mutate caller input.
Abort rule: If heap > 96 MiB on /tmp/window-2m.ndjson, abort Map version, profile key retention.
Rollback: Restore 7b31c2a (correct only for unique-user input).
Open: Malformed negative timestamps: throw or skip?
Success: Tests pass, 2M events < 2s, heap < 96 MiB.
Next

Redis->PG session migration. Src: sess:v3:, Dst: auth.session_v4. 12,480,331 keys (02:00 UTC). 0.06% missing user_agent (NULL ok).
Constraints: <=4k writes/s, lag <4s, login err <0.8%.
Failed: SCAN COUNT 10000/32w -> 11.7k w/s, 19s lag. Revert only if cap >12k w/s & prod test lag <4s.
Failed: KEYS sess:v3:* -> 6.2s block. Never use KEYS in prod.
Plan: SCAN COUNT 500, 6 workers, token bucket 3.5k w/s. Checkpoint /var/lib/auth-migrate/checkpoint.json every 50k keys.
Start: `/opt/auth/bin/migrate-sessions --prefix sess:v3: --workers 6 --rate 3500 --shadow`
Verify: After 30m, SHA-256 on 25k sample. Check Lua ms precision.
Promote gates: mismatch <0.02%, p99 <35ms, err <0.8% for 20m.
Abort: lag >=4s or rate >4k/s.
Rollback: flag auth.session-read-v4=false. Keep table 7 days. Delete only if AUTH-209 closed.
Q: Count expired keys as mismatches?
Next: Run shadow cmd. Success requires passing gates.

parsed.rollback: flag auth.session-read-v4=false. Keep table 7 days. Delete only if AUTH-209 closed.
parsed.reconsider: Revert only if cap >12k w/s & prod test lag <4s.

records.text: Rotate internal mTLS issuer. Old: SHA256:4A:19:7C:EE, exp 2026-08-12T03:00:00Z. New: SHA256:91:B0:2D:6F, /etc/pki/mesh/issuer-next.pem. 43 legacy agents (<v5.4.2) lack dual trust. Canary edge-07 single-step replace failed: 14.2% handshake errors (leaf chained to old only); restored in 38s. Rule: trust rollout before identity. No single-step replace until zero <v5.4.2 agents. No disabling cert verification. Order: 1. Append new issuer (keep old). 2. Verify. 3. Issue dual-compatible leaves. 4. Verify. 5. Remove old issuer last. Cmd: `ansible-playbook -i inventories/prod rotate-trust.yml --limit edge-canary --check`. Keep `--check` first run. Gate: 10k synthetic handshakes, 0 unknown_ca, p99 <120ms. Legacy agents may need restart; wait for legacy-12 reconnect. Abort if unknown_ca >0.1% or clock skew >2s. Rollback pre-leaf: restore /etc/pki/mesh/ca-bundle.pem.bak. Post-leaf rollback: re-add both issuers, reissue old-chain leaves. Removing only new issuer strands new leaves. Q: SEC-144 allows restarts, unclear on firmware updates. Next: `ansible-playbook -i inventories/prod rotate-trust.yml --limit edge-canary --check`. Keep old issuer until mesh_old_chain_connections=0 for 24h

Model: atlas-34b, 1x RTX 6000 Ada (48 GiB).
Workload: 70% interactive (1200 in, 180 out), 30% batch (8000 in, 600 out).
Hard gates: interactive p95 TTFT < 900 ms, >= 18 tok/s/req, no OOM in 60m soak.

Results:
- fp16: 67.4 GiB (OOM, fail).
- q8: 39.8 GiB, TTFT 1140 ms (fail), 26.1 tok/s. Stable fallback.
- q4_k_m: 25.6 GiB, TTFT 712 ms (pass), 22.7 tok/s (pass).
- spec q4_k_m+draft: 31.2 GiB, TTFT 804 ms, 31.5 tok/s. Crashed at 47m (CUDA 700). Fail.

Decision: Speculative rejected due to soak failure. Lowering draft len 8->4 stopped crash in 20m, but insufficient evidence. Do not report fixed. Reconsider spec only after 3x 60m soaks with 0 CUDA errors.
Provisional: q4_k_m (no draft).

Next action: `./bench-atlas --profile q4_k_m --concurrency 6 --duration 60m --json /tmp/atlas-q4-soak.json`
Constraints:
- Max concurrency 6 until KV < 44 GiB.
- Abort soak if: GPU mem > 44 GiB, ECC > 0, or interactive p95 > 900 ms for 5 min.
- Rollback: set ATLAS_PROFILE
